title: Circle Area & Circumference
subject: Geometry
summary: The area of a circle is π times the radius squared. The circumference is 2π times the radius.

video.title: Area of a circle, how to get the formula

title: Pythagorean Theorem
subject: Geometry
summary: In a right triangle, the square of the hypotenuse equals the sum of the squares of the other two sides.

video.title: How many ways are there to prove the Pythagorean theorem?

title: Heron's Formula (Triangle Area)
subject: Geometry
summary: Calculates the area of any triangle from the lengths of its three sides without needing the height.

title: Sphere Volume & Surface Area
subject: Geometry
summary: The volume of a sphere is (4/3)πr³ and its surface area is 4πr².

title: Euler's Polyhedron Formula
subject: Geometry
summary: For any convex polyhedron, the number of vertices minus edges plus faces always equals 2.

title: Quadratic Formula
subject: Algebra
summary: Finds the roots of any quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0 using the discriminant.

video.title: The simpler quadratic formula | Ep. 1 Lockdown live math

title: Binomial Theorem
subject: Algebra
summary: Expands any power of a binomial (a + b)ⁿ using combinatorial coefficients.

title: Difference of Squares
subject: Algebra
summary: Core algebraic identity stating that a² - b² factors into (a - b)(a + b).

title: Slope & Linear Equation
subject: Algebra
summary: Slope measures rate of change, and slope-intercept form represents any non-vertical straight line.
formulaLatex: m = \frac{y_2 - y_1}{x_2 - x_1},\quad y = mx + c

title: Euclidean Distance Formula
subject: Algebra
summary: Calculates the straight-line distance between two points (x₁, y₁) and (x₂, y₂) in a 2D plane.

title: Midpoint Formula
subject: Algebra
summary: Finds the exact middle point of a line segment joining two coordinate endpoints.

title: Dot Product & Angle Between Vectors
subject: Linear Algebra
summary: Computes the inner product of two vectors. Equals zero if and only if the vectors are orthogonal (perpendicular).

title: Vector Cross Product (3D)
subject: Linear Algebra
summary: Yields a 3D vector perpendicular to both inputs with magnitude equal to the area of the spanned parallelogram.
formulaLatex: \mathbf{u} \times \mathbf{v} = \det\begin{pmatrix} \mathbf{i} & \mathbf{j} & \mathbf{k} \\ u_x & u_y & u_z \\ v_x & v_y & v_z \end{pmatrix}

title: Orthogonal Vector Projection
subject: Linear Algebra
summary: Decomposes a vector into its component in the direction of another vector and its orthogonal complement.

title: Matrix Multiplication (AB)
subject: Linear Algebra
summary: Composes linear transformations by taking dot products between rows of the first matrix and columns of the second.

title: Matrix Determinant
subject: Linear Algebra
summary: Scalar property measuring how a matrix scales area or volume. A matrix is invertible if and only if det(A) ≠ 0.
formulaLatex: \det\begin{pmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{pmatrix} = ad - bc

title: Matrix Inverse (2×2)
subject: Linear Algebra
summary: Calculates the unique inverse matrix A⁻¹ such that AA⁻¹ = I, enabling direct solution of linear systems Ax = b.

title: Eigenvalues & Eigenvectors
subject: Linear Algebra
summary: Finds invariant directional axes where transformation A acts purely as scalar multiplication Av = λv.

video.title: Eigenvectors and eigenvalues (Essence of linear algebra, Ch. 14)

title: Rank-Nullity Theorem
subject: Linear Algebra
summary: Fundamental theorem of linear transformations stating that dim(Domain) = rank(T) + nullity(T).

title: Gram-Schmidt Orthogonalization
subject: Linear Algebra
summary: Converts an arbitrary linearly independent set of vectors into an orthogonal or orthonormal basis.

title: Singular Value Decomposition (SVD)
subject: Linear Algebra
summary: Factorizes any m×n matrix into orthogonal matrices U, V and singular values Σ. Central to modern data science & PCA.

video.title: Singular Value Decomposition (SVD): Overview

title: Gradient of a Scalar Field (∇f)
subject: Calculus
summary: Vector field of partial derivatives pointing in the direction of steepest ascent of a multivariable function.
formulaLatex: \nabla f = \left(\dfrac{\partial f}{\partial x},\; \dfrac{\partial f}{\partial y},\; \dfrac{\partial f}{\partial z}\right)

title: Divergence of a Vector Field (∇·F)
subject: Calculus
summary: Scalar quantity measuring the net outward flux density of a vector field from an infinitesimal volume.
formulaLatex: \nabla \cdot \mathbf{F} = \dfrac{\partial F_x}{\partial x} + \dfrac{\partial F_y}{\partial y} + \dfrac{\partial F_z}{\partial z}

title: Curl of a Vector Field (∇×F)
subject: Calculus
summary: Vector quantity describing the infinitesimal rotation and circulation of a 3D vector field.
formulaLatex: \nabla \times \mathbf{F} = \det\begin{pmatrix} \mathbf{i} & \mathbf{j} & \mathbf{k} \\ \frac{\partial}{\partial x} & \frac{\partial}{\partial y} & \frac{\partial}{\partial z} \\ F_x & F_y & F_z \end{pmatrix}

title: Green's Theorem in the Plane
subject: Calculus
summary: Equates the macroscopic line integral around a simple closed curve to the double integral of 2D curl over the interior.
formulaLatex: \oint_{\partial D} (L\,dx + M\,dy) = \iint_D \left(\dfrac{\partial M}{\partial x} - \dfrac{\partial L}{\partial y}\right) dA

title: Stokes' Theorem
subject: Calculus
summary: Relates the surface integral of curl over an oriented surface to the line integral of the vector field along its boundary.

title: Gauss's Divergence Theorem
subject: Calculus
summary: States that the total outward flux of a vector field through a closed boundary surface equals the volume integral of divergence.

title: First-Order Linear ODE (Integrating Factor)
subject: Calculus
summary: Solves y' + P(x)y = Q(x) by multiplying by the integrating factor I(x) = exp(∫ P(x)dx).
formulaLatex: y' + P(x)y = Q(x) \implies y(x) = \dfrac{1}{I(x)}\left(\int I(x)Q(x)\,dx + C\right)

title: Laplace Transform
subject: Calculus
summary: Converts continuous time-domain differential equations into algebraic equations in complex s-space.

title: Fourier Series Expansion
subject: Calculus
summary: Represents any piecewise smooth periodic function as an infinite superposition of sines and cosines.

title: Euler's Formula & Identity
subject: Foundations
summary: Unites exponential growth and circular motion in the complex plane: e^(iθ) = cos θ + i sin θ.

title: Cauchy-Riemann Equations
subject: Calculus
summary: Fundamental conditions connecting real and imaginary components for a complex function to be complex differentiable.
formulaLatex: \dfrac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \dfrac{\partial v}{\partial y},\quad \dfrac{\partial u}{\partial y} = -\dfrac{\partial v}{\partial x}

title: GCD & LCM
subject: Number Theory
summary: The greatest common divisor and least common multiple, computed using the Euclidean algorithm.

title: Fermat's Little Theorem
subject: Number Theory
summary: If p is prime and gcd(a, p) = 1, then a^(p-1) is congruent to 1 modulo p. Powers RSA cryptography.

title: Modular Congruence & Arithmetic
subject: Number Theory
summary: Multiplication and addition preserve modular congruences, enabling efficient large-number computations.

title: Compound Interest Formula
subject: Foundations
summary: Calculates future investment value with compounding interest over time periods.

title: Arithmetic Sequence & Sum

summary: Finds the nth term and sum of numbers with a constant difference between consecutive terms.

title: Geometric Sequence & Series
subject: Foundations
summary: Calculates finite and infinite sums where each consecutive term is multiplied by a common ratio r.

subject: Counting & Probability

title: Probability & Bayes' Theorem
subject: Counting & Probability

title: Inclusion-Exclusion Principle
subject: Counting & Probability
summary: Calculates the size of the union of overlapping sets by adding sizes and subtracting intersections.

title: Expected Value
subject: Counting & Probability

title: Mean & Standard Deviation
subject: Statistics

title: Z-Score (Standard Score)

summary: Measures how many standard deviations an observation falls away from the population mean.

title: Standard Error of the Mean
subject: Statistics
summary: Estimates the variability of sample means drawn repeatedly from the same population.

title: Derivatives & Tangent Slope
subject: Calculus

title: Product Rule for Differentiation
subject: Calculus
summary: Differentiates products of functions: the derivative of uv is u'v + uv'.

title: Quotient Rule for Differentiation
subject: Calculus
summary: Calculates the derivative of a quotient of two differentiable functions.

title: Chain Rule for Composite Functions
subject: Calculus

title: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
subject: Calculus

title: Integration by Parts
subject: Calculus
summary: Inverts the product rule to integrate products of functions: ∫ u dv = uv - ∫ v du.

title: Trigonometric Unit Circle
subject: Trigonometry
summary: The unit circle defines sin and cos as coordinates of a point on a circle of radius 1.

title: Law of Sines
subject: Trigonometry
summary: States that the ratio of each side of a triangle to the sine of its opposite angle is constant.

title: Law of Cosines
subject: Trigonometry
summary: Generalizes the Pythagorean theorem to any arbitrary triangle, relating three sides and one angle.

title: Double Angle Formulas
subject: Trigonometry
summary: Key trigonometric identities expressing sin(2θ) and cos(2θ) in terms of single-angle functions.

title: Time Complexity & Big O

summary: Big O notation describes how an algorithm's running time scales with input size.

title: Master Theorem for Recurrences

title: Shannon Information Entropy
subject: CSE & Competitive Programming
summary: Quantifies the expected amount of information, uncertainty, or minimum bits needed to encode a message.

title: De Morgan's Laws

summary: Fundamental dualities in logic: the negation of a conjunction is the disjunction of negations, and vice versa.

title: Euler's Planar Graph Formula

title: Catalan Numbers
subject: CSE & Competitive Programming

subject: Number Theory

title: Chinese Remainder Theorem (CRT)
subject: Number Theory
summary: Guarantees a unique solution modulo the product of pairwise coprime moduli for a system of simultaneous congruences.
formulaLatex: x \equiv \sum_{i=1}^k a_i M_i y_i \pmod{M},\quad M = \prod_{i=1}^k m_i

title: Birthday Paradox & Hash Collisions
subject: CSE & Competitive Programming

summary: Converts a sequence of values into components of different frequencies, computable in O(n log n) using Cooley-Tukey FFT.
formulaLatex: X_k = \sum_{n=0}^{N-1} x_n e^{-i\frac{2\pi k n}{N}},\quad k = 0, \dots, N-1

subject: CSE & Competitive Programming

title: Cosine Similarity & Distance
subject: Linear Algebra
summary: Measures orientation similarity between two nonzero vectors in an inner product space, independent of magnitude.

title: L1 & L2 Vector Norms (Manhattan vs Euclidean)

title: Sigmoid / Logistic Function
subject: Calculus

title: Gaussian / Normal Distribution PDF
subject: Statistics

title: Poisson Distribution PMF
subject: Statistics
summary: Models the probability of a given number of events occurring in a fixed interval with average rate lambda.

subject: Statistics

subject: Statistics

subject: Geometry
summary: Computes the enclosed area of any triangle from the Cartesian coordinates of its three vertices.

title: Sum of First n Natural Numbers & Squares
subject: Foundations
summary: Closed-form formulas for the sum of the first n positive integers and their squares.

title: General Equation of a Circle
subject: Geometry
summary: Second-degree equation representing a circle with center (-g, -f) and radius sqrt(g² + f² - c).
